item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 20/Mar/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today and in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, a band of clouds will cover the region. With the easterly airstream moderating, the weather will improve gradually over Guangdong early to midweek next week. It will be rather warm during the day and hot over inland areas.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few light rain patches.
Temp range: 20 - 23 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
